question: Should OpenClaw retain the all-or-nothing legacy beta DSSE envelope parser, and if so what supported snapshot window and removal trigger govern it?
rationale: This is a signed-input trust-boundary policy choice: the code can mechanically support either grammar, but only maintainers can define whether beta-produced envelopes remain an accepted compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve bounded beta compatibility
options.body: Retain the legacy parser only for the identified 2026.7.2 beta snapshots and record a concrete removal trigger and owner.

options.title: Standard DSSE only
options.body: Remove legacy-envelope acceptance now and require all configured hosted-feed producers to emit standard DSSE fields.

options.title: Pause for feed-spec alignment
options.body: Hold this PR until the Hosted Feed specification and producer rollout define the migration window.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded beta compatibility
recommendation.body: Retain the legacy parser only for the identified 2026.7.2 beta snapshots and record a concrete removal trigger and owner.

likelyOwner.reason: No specific current-main owner could be established from the provided history without local provenance inspection.
